fixed_causes: Attachment parsing recognized attach/find/search but rejected add and other natural verbs.
Messages new-message drafts retain a generic window title; committed recipient chips were not captured, so automatic attachment staging had no destination.
The first recent-download resolution was asynchronous but automatic staging did not wait for it.

native_voice_test.scope: Installed native app, actual helper Fn events, physical microphone and real cloud inference.
native_voice_test.spoken_command: Flow, add the screenshot showing Call me Ishmael.
native_voice_test.recipient_scope: New, unsent Messages draft with committed recipient chips and a generic window title.

diagnostic_voice_test.scope: Production AppState in an isolated diagnostic host with in-memory history; real microphone, real cloud inference, production HUD and actual Messages insertion. Not the installed bundle or helper.

native_ocr_and_replacement_regression.scope: Supplied local search intent → actual Spotlight and Apple Vision OCR → production auto-append and candidate replacement in actual Messages. Synthetic screenshots only. No audio, ASR or LLM API calls. No Send event.

privacy: Raw voice recordings, screenshot previews, Messages contents, recipient labels and detailed timing traces remain private under .build/.
limitations: One native microphone take; timings are not median/p95 guarantees.
The recorded microphone test verifies the add alias and screenshot search. Other aliases and source combinations were covered by parser tests, not separate microphone recordings.
The first-use recent-download wait was corrected but this recorded run does not claim a download autopaste test.
No Send was generated, so this run does not train or verify newly saved contact style rules.
